turns.input: Sister Mereth gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration:
Sister Mereth pulls off her own worn leather boots, tucking her bare feet under her hem with a grimace of practicality, and thrusts the pair toward Nicco. "You look like you've been tramping around in whatever you arrived in. These'll serve better."

She says nothing else, already turning her attention to the document bag at her hip, checking its ties as if the matter were settled.

Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
Sister Mereth's weathered hand closes around the leather boots Nicco extends toward her. She does not withdraw them, but her grip tightens, and she studies him with the same assessing look she might turn on a child offering a valuable found object.

"You've no boots at all, then?" The grey-haired woman's voice carries the flat weariness of someone who has learned to suspect generosity. "These won't fit any of mine. They're for a grown man's foot, and I've none of those needing charity." She glances down at Nicco's feet, then back to his face. "Keep them. Or if you won't, leave them at the tavern—someone there'll take them." She relaxes her hand, offering the boots once more, her tone sharpening toward practicality. "I don't carry goods back and forth for pride's sake. Decide what you're doing with them."
